summary: Frontend-only smoke of the new PT-PT LandingPortugal on '/'. Landing renders in PT with all sections (hero, master video section, intro video section, 191 trabalhos, features, catálogo, DIY, audiences, FAQ, blog, footer). /fr correctly redirects (client-side Navigate) to /. Nav no longer has MarketToggle. No visible FR strings from the forbidden list. However 2 CRITICAL bugs found: (1) BOTH videos never render on PT landing due to guard `{lang !== 'pt' && (...)}` around <video> tags (hero-pt.mp4 and demo-pt.mp4 are NOT in the DOM/HTML). The screenshot shows empty black boxes where videos should be. (2) Stale PT translations in src/lib/landingI18n.js OVERRIDE the updated PT constants in LandingPortugal.jsx, so FAQ, audiences and video-section copy still show old strings — notably FAQ a1 shows '500 a 1 100 €/m²' (not '500 a 1 400'), FAQ q4/a4 mention 'IVA a 10%' (not 'IVA 6% (Verba 2.27)'), FAQ a5 does not mention 'Leroy Merlin, AKI, Maxmat'. Audience label shows 'Artesãos' / 'IVA à taxa correta (23% ou 6%)' rather than 'Profissionais da construção' / 'IVA 6% (reabilitação)'. Some code fallbacks also mix PT+FR ('Ativar le son').

ui_bugs.issue: Hero master video does NOT render on PT landing. JSX wraps <video src='/hero-pt.mp4'> in `{lang !== 'pt' && (...)}` (line 391), so on lang='pt' the <video> element is never rendered. `document.querySelectorAll('video').length === 0` and 'hero-pt.mp4' is absent from the served HTML/DOM. Also the container is `aspect-video` (16:9) whereas the request states hero should permit portrait orientation.

Demo video (/demo-pt.mp4) also never renders — same `{lang !== 'pt' && (...)}` guard around <video> AND around the sound-toggle button (lines 470 & 485). Result: the phone-shaped frame is empty in production. `data-testid='intro-video-player'` and `video-sound-toggle` are not in DOM.

PT translations are stale and override the new PT constants defined in LandingPortugal.jsx. Rendered UI shows old strings instead of the requested ones. Specifically: FAQ q1/a1 -> '500 a 1 100 €/m²' (should be '500 a 1 400 €/m²'); FAQ q4/a4 -> 'IVA a 10%' + 'renovação de habitações com mais de 2 anos' (should be 'IVA 6% (Verba 2.27)' + Verba 2.27 CIVA text); FAQ a5 does not cite Leroy Merlin, AKI, Maxmat, Bricomarché, Sotinco, Weber; audiences show 'Artesãos'/'IVA à taxa correta (23% ou 6%)' instead of 'Profissionais da construção'/'IVA 6% (reabilitação)'; 'Escolas de construção' instead of 'Escolas técnicas'; step titles from STEPS array ('Descrevo o meu projeto' etc.) are not visible on the page at all — the intro section renders the video-step list ('Importação da planta PDF / DWG…') sourced from i18n, not the STEPS constant.

Several fallback default strings in t() calls mix PT + FR: 'Ativar le son' (should be 'Ativar o som'), 'Découvrez ConstruPilot', 'L'estimation BTP, réinventée.', 'Voyez comment ConstruPilot lit vos plans', 'Import du plan PDF/DWG', etc. Currently masked by PT i18n keys, but will leak FR if any key is missing.

The STEPS array (Descrevo o meu projeto / O ConstruPilot entende / O motor calcula / Encontro os melhores preços / Sei o que fazer sozinho / Chamo um profissional se precisar) is defined but I could not find where it is rendered on the page — none of these six titles appear in the rendered body. Possibly dead code or a missing <section> that was expected per the review request.

issues: Large black rectangle with no content because <video> element is not rendered (see CRITICAL above). The sound-toggle button is still rendered on master section but does nothing since no <video> is mounted.

action_items: REMOVE the `{lang !== 'pt' && (...)}` guards around the two <video> blocks and the intro sound-toggle button in /app/frontend/src/pages/LandingPortugal.jsx (lines 391, 470, 485) so hero-pt.mp4 and demo-pt.mp4 render on the PT landing. Change master container to portrait aspect (e.g., aspect-[9/16] or a phone-like frame) since hero-pt.mp4 is described as vertical.

UPDATE /app/frontend/src/lib/landingI18n.js pt block to match the requirements: FAQ a1 -> '500 a 1 400 €/m²'; FAQ q4/a4 -> 'IVA 6% (Verba 2.27)' with Verba 2.27 CIVA copy; FAQ a5 -> cite Leroy Merlin, AKI, Maxmat, Bricomarché, Sotinco, Weber; audiences -> 'Profissionais da construção' + 'IVA 6% (reabilitação)' text; rename 'Escolas de construção' -> 'Escolas técnicas'.
Render the STEPS constant (6 items 'Descrevo o meu projeto' … 'Chamo um profissional se precisar') in a visible section on the landing — currently defined but never mapped to JSX.

Clean the FR fallback strings in t() calls inside LandingPortugal.jsx (translate 'Ativar le son', 'Découvrez ConstruPilot', 'L'estimation BTP, réinventée.', etc. to PT) so a missing i18n key won't leak FR.
critical_code_review_comments: Rendering guard `{lang !== 'pt' && ...}` on the two <video> tags in LandingPortugal.jsx is contradictory to the file's purpose (LandingPortugal is served ONLY when lang='pt' effectively) — it guarantees videos never render on this page.

Duplicate source of truth for PT copy: PT strings are defined both in LandingPortugal.jsx constants (STEPS/FEATURES/AUDIENCES/FAQ) and in landingI18n.js pt block, and i18n wins. Constants become dead. Consolidate to one source.
FR fallback strings still present all over the JSX file — hides bugs by relying on i18n keys existing; risky.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://construpilot-recon.preview.emergentagent.com/. Only '/' and '/fr' were tested. /fr Navigate redirect confirmed. Nav MarketToggle removal confirmed. The two blocking bugs (videos wrapped in lang!=='pt' guard AND stale pt i18n in src/lib/landingI18n.js) must be fixed by main agent before retest. After fix, retest that: (a) <video data-testid='master-video-player'> exists with src '/hero-pt.mp4', (b) <video data-testid='intro-video-player'> exists with src '/demo-pt.mp4', (c) FAQ a1 contains '1 400', FAQ q4 contains 'Verba 2.27' and 'IVA 6%', FAQ a5 lists 'Leroy Merlin' 'AKI' 'Maxmat', (d) 6 STEPS titles are visible on the page, (e) audience card shows 'Profissionais da construção'.
rca of the issue: Two independent root causes: (1) In LandingPortugal.jsx the developer left the `{lang !== 'pt' && (...)}` guards that presumably existed in the FR original to hide videos from PT market when videos were FR-only. After renaming master.mp4/demo-plans.mp4 to hero-pt.mp4/demo-pt.mp4 and cloning the file into LandingPortugal.jsx (which is served ONLY when lang='pt'), the guard now unconditionally hides the videos it was supposed to show. (2) The clone updated PT copy inside JSX constants but did not update the pt block of src/lib/landingI18n.js, which is queried first by t() and therefore wins — so old PT strings continue to render. Fix: remove the lang guards for videos + refresh pt i18n dictionary with the new PT-PT copy.
